[B1] < deviceA | 'buttonPressed' : false , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceA
=> < deviceA | 'buttonPressed' : true , ... > .
[B2] < deviceA | 'buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : OldKey , ... > $ UserX 'setKey' deviceA | (Key)
=> < deviceA | 'buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceA 'sendBindKey' cloudA | (Key) .
[B2] < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindKey' : OldKey , ...) > $ deviceA 'sendBindKey' cloudA | (Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindKey' : Key , ...) > .
[B3] < deviceA | 'buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'retrieveKey' deviceA
=> < deviceA | 'buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceA 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : OldKey , ... > $ deviceA 'sendKey' UserX | (Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindKey' : Key , 'owner' : nils , ...) > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (deviceA ; Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindKey' : Key , 'owner' : UserX , ...) > .
[B5] < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindKey' : Key , 'owner' : UserX , ...) > $ UserX 'resetDevice' cloudA | (deviceA ; Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindKey' : nils , 'owner' : nils , ...) > .
[B6] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > .
[B7] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
